rationale: The current best script already shows that a rank-64 previous-token residual head is the highest-leverage use of the remaining byte budget. This change keeps that winning path intact but makes the bigram branch context-conditional: a zero-initialized hidden-to-rank gate modulates the existing bigram factors before projection, so the model can learn when each previous-token feature should matter without changing shapes, breaking compile stability, or paying for another full output head. The added matrix stays under the <=65536 keep-float cutoff, so it should remain export-friendly while giving the strongest existing tail more expressive power.
title: Hidden-Gated Bigram Rank 64 Tail
